title: Count crashes automatically
text: Bugs like T-4367 would show within hours of a publish if the game sent the server a count of 'Demand stopped' and similar failures (version, the error's first line, phone or computer; nothing about the player), shown on twstats. Today we only hear when a player writes in. Worth building? It's a game and server change, so yours to say.

title: Flyover refusal text
text: T-4379 landed: while drawing, 'One track is still on its ramp where they cross, so they are less than a level apart. Cross past the end of the ramp. Each level needs at least 160 m of ramp.' (was 'Tracks cannot cross on a ramp unless they are a full level apart.'); the red crossing mark's hover 'One track is still on its ramp here' (was 'Tracks cross on a ramp less than a level apart'). Japanese in notes/T-4379.md. OK, or reworded?

title: Start T-4372
text: Start T-4372 (smoke plays a second game with phone settings: intercity trips off, one worker, long lines), which would have caught the 0.4.7 crash? About 1-2 hours of agent work. I'd say yes.

title: Cores slider text
text: T-3932 landed (8800 has it): 'Use more cores' -> 'Cores', its old hover removed. New: 'Auto' (hover 'Picked for your device and how big the game is'); 'Uses about {gb} GB' (red hover 'The game runs on fewer cores when it would pass {gb} GB'); 'Loads in about {time}'; 'Trips are calculated in about {time} after an edit'; 'Running on {n} cores to fit in memory'; 'Applies after a reload'; 'Reload' (reused). Text acknowledged, or which lines to reword?
